text: 8月25日，深圳海事局与欣旺达签订合作备忘录，共建“绿色海事智能创新应用中心”，双方将聚焦绿色能源替代、智能装备验证与监管模式等创新领域，共同培育海事新质生产力、推动航运低碳转型。
text_en: On August 25, Shenzhen Maritime Safety Administration and Sunwoda signed a cooperation memorandum to jointly build a "Green Maritime Intelligent Innovation Application Center," focusing on innovative areas such as green energy substitution, smart equipment validation, and regulatory models, working together to foster new maritime productive forces and promote low-carbon transformation in shipping.
